# Contributing

We are a human-first project. All contributions must be human-authored.

## Policy on AI tools

No AI tools are permitted for generating code, documentation, or commit messages.
AI is not allowed in any part of the contribution workflow.
We do not accept AI-generated content in pull requests.

All submissions must be human-written. Contributions found to be AI-generated
will be closed without review.

If you use Copilot or ChatGPT to draft code, that is not allowed in this project.

## Contribution process

1. Fork the repository
2. Write your changes by hand
3. Submit a PR with a clear description
